acceptance.note: Coreform Table 4 maximum observed absolute errors across all 6 (p, C) variants: Face U <= 1.51e-5, ODB Surface U <= 1.42e-5, Interior S <= 5.46e-5 (all 6 stress components including zero shear). Must also be re-passed with extension enabled per G2.

boundary_conditions.note: Six standard uniformly distributed displacement BCs prescribing one normal component on each face; remaining components unconstrained except along intersecting edges/corners.

loads.note: No force or traction is applied.

materials.abaqus_step: Static, General with NLGEOM=OFF (small-displacement, infinitesimal strain)

mesh_sweep.discretization: immersed trimmed U-splines, edge-centered rectilinear background grid

probes.face_probes: 21 x 21 (441 points) per face, including edges, center, and projected grid planes at 0.2 and 0.8
probes.interior_probes: 3 x 3 x 3 (27 points) at {0.1, 0.5, 0.9}^3, all 6 stress components
probes.odb_surface_sets: SFM3D3 surface element set + paired node set on each trimmed face
